title: Kamailio
description: The edge's SIP proxy: requests and replies, INVITE outcomes, transactions, what it refuses or loses, memory, and its dispatcher list.

panels.title: Pods scraped
panels.description: Kamailio pods whose metrics answered the last scrape.

panels.title: INVITEs
panels.description: New INVITEs received per second, last 5 minutes.

panels.title: INVITEs answered (ASR)
panels.description: Of the final replies to INVITE that Kamailio received from the nodes over the selected range, the share that were 2xx: the answer-seizure ratio as the proxy sees it. A 487 (caller cancelled) counts as unanswered, as it does for carriers. The 408s Kamailio sends itself when no node answers aren't replies it received: see Requests lost.

targets.expr: sum(increase(kamailio_core_rcv_replies_2xx_invite{job="kamailio", namespace=~"$namespace", fleet=~"$fleet", pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])) / sum(increase({__name__=~"kamailio_core_rcv_replies_2xx_invite|kamailio_core_rcv_replies_3xx_invite|kamailio_core_rcv_replies_4xx_invite|kamailio_core_rcv_replies_5xx_invite|kamailio_core_rcv_replies_6xx_invite", job="kamailio", namespace=~"$namespace", fleet=~"$fleet", pod=~"$pod"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Transactions in progress
panels.description: tm transactions not yet completed, across the selected pods.

panels.title: Shared memory used (worst pod)
panels.description: Shared memory in use, fragmentation included, of what Kamailio was started with (-m). When it runs out Kamailio can't create transactions and starts refusing requests.

targets.expr: max(kamailio_shmem_real_used_size{job="kamailio", namespace=~"$namespace", fleet=~"$fleet", pod=~"$pod"} / kamailio_shmem_total_size{job="kamailio", namespace=~"$namespace", fleet=~"$fleet", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: Requests lost
panels.description: Requests the caller got a 408 for over the selected range, because every node tried stayed silent (the edge's kamailio_silent_drops_total).

panels.title: Requests received by method
panels.description: Every request Kamailio received, from callers and from the nodes. OPTIONS include the dispatcher's own keepalive replies' counterparts from the nodes.

targets.expr: sum(rate(kamailio_core_rcv_requests{job="kamailio", namespace=~"$namespace", fleet=~"$fleet", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) - sum(rate(kamailio_core_rcv_requests_invite{job="kamailio", namespace=~"$namespace", fleet=~"$fleet", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) - sum(rate(kamailio_core_rcv_requests_ack{job="kamailio", namespace=~"$namespace", fleet=~"$fleet", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) - sum(rate(kamailio_core_rcv_requests_bye{job="kamailio", namespace=~"$namespace", fleet=~"$fleet", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) - sum(rate(kamailio_core_rcv_requests_cancel{job="kamailio", namespace=~"$namespace", fleet=~"$fleet", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) - sum(rate(kamailio_core_rcv_requests_options{job="kamailio", namespace=~"$namespace", fleet=~"$fleet", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Final replies to INVITE, by class
panels.description: Final replies Kamailio received for INVITEs, from the nodes: how calls set up through the proxy ended.

panels.title: Replies received, by class
panels.description: All replies, to every method, provisional included.

panels.title: 4xx replies by code (over the range)
panels.description: Which 4xx the nodes answered with: all of them, then each code seen in the range. 486/487 are a callee busy and a caller who hung up first; 404/484 a number no route matches; 408 no answer in time; 488 no common codec; 401/407/403 authentication.

panels.title: Forwarded and dropped
panels.description: Messages Kamailio sent on statelessly, and those its script dropped (drop or exit without a reply).

panels.title: Transactions in progress
panels.description: Active: not yet completed. In use: still in memory, completed ones waiting out their timers included. In use climbing while active stays flat is transactions not being freed.

panels.title: New transactions
panels.description: Kamailio forwards statefully: each request it relays opens a server transaction toward the caller and a client transaction toward a node; failover to another node opens another client transaction.

panels.title: Replies handled by tm
panels.description: Absorbed: replies tm kept back (retransmissions, and the losers of a failover). Generated: replies Kamailio created itself, such as the 408 when no node answered.

panels.title: Replies Kamailio sends itself (stateless)
panels.description: Replies from the sl module: Kamailio's own answers outside a transaction (keepalive OPTIONS, a refusal before relaying).

panels.title: Refused before any node saw it
panels.description: The edge's kamailio_rejected_requests_total. untrusted_source: dropped unanswered, the source isn't in spec.trustedPeers (scanners, mostly). sanity: the sanity module's own 4xx. uri_scheme: 416. display_name: a From or To a node would discard.

panels.title: Nodes that stayed silent
panels.description: A node that doesn't answer in 5 s is tried no further for that request; the next node is. When every node tried stays silent the caller gets a 408. cause=nodes: no node answered anything (the fleet may be down); cause=request: the nodes are up and discarded this one request.

panels.title: Malformed and failed
panels.description: Messages Kamailio couldn't parse or route, and its DNS lookups that failed or took long.

panels.title: Shared memory used, by pod
panels.description: Shared memory holds transactions, the dispatcher list and the htable. Peak is the most used since start. Steady growth without traffic to match is a leak.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (kamailio_shmem_real_used_size{job="kamailio", namespace=~"$namespace", fleet=~"$fleet", pod=~"$pod"}) / sum by (pod) (kamailio_shmem_total_size{job="kamailio", namespace=~"$namespace", fleet=~"$fleet", pod=~"$pod"})

sum by (pod) (kamailio_shmem_max_used_size{job="kamailio", namespace=~"$namespace", fleet=~"$fleet", pod=~"$pod"}) / sum by (pod) (kamailio_shmem_total_size{job="kamailio", namespace=~"$namespace", fleet=~"$fleet", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: Shared memory fragments, by pod
panels.description: Free fragments. A rising count with flat usage is fragmentation: large allocations can fail with memory to spare.

panels.title: TCP
panels.description: SIP over TCP, when callers or nodes use it (UDP is the default). Errors: connects that failed, resets, timeouts, a full send queue, connections refused locally.

panels.title: Destinations, by set
panels.description: Nodes in the dispatcher list the operator last wrote. Draining nodes leave it.

panels.title: Dispatcher list updates and reloads
panels.description: Each change to the fleet rewrites the list and asks every Kamailio to reload it. not_loaded: a Kamailio answered but still held the old list; retried.

panels.title: Reload pending
panels.description: Pending: the list changed and not every Kamailio is confirmed to hold it. Calls may go to a node that is leaving, or miss a new one.

panels.title: CPU by pod
panels.description: Cores the kamailio container uses, against its request and limit (when set).

panels.title: Memory by pod (working set)
panels.description: The working set is what the kernel counts against the limit: at the limit, the container is OOM-killed.

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: Restarts of every container in the selected pods.
